description: Radi8 holds your brand context, content strategy and monthly plan, and keeps what you publish aligned with them. Connected to ChatGPT, it lets you read that context in the conversation, draft a post against it, check the draft against what you have already published on that channel, attach an image from your media library, and put the post on the calendar for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook or TikTok. Posts publish at their scheduled time, so there is always a window to change your mind. Requires a Radi8 account.

defaultPrompt: Draft a LinkedIn post in my brand voice about what we shipped this week
What's in my content plan this month, and what haven't I posted about yet?
Show me what's scheduled this week and move anything that clashes
